title: Child and Adolescent Labour Wave 5I legal and safeguarding review decision boundary
safeguardingRequirements: Do not collect child/adolescent identity, exact age/date of birth or case-level safeguarding information in this feature.
Any live concern must be escalated through an approved human safeguarding route outside retrieval/provider execution.
The provider cannot classify a person or activity, decide an exception or offence, or recommend a case disposition.
notes: Passing deterministic, retrieval or browser tests is not legal or safeguarding approval.
Exact controlled full-file source acquisition and qualified legal/privacy/safeguarding review remain open gates.
